Faye: Quick PM follow-up - we need owners for postmortem action items focused on tests/evals to prevent KV-eviction regressions.
Omar: Proposed items: prompt set (25 cases), nightly eviction regression, burst load template, 20-min chaos drill, rollout gating for critical prompts.
Faye: I'll own the prompt set (due 2025-03-10). Using recorded traces + synthetic augmentation; will include pass/fail criteria.
Omar: I'll own nightly regression + gating RFC (gating threshold: block if critical prompt drops >5%). Target 2025-03-15.
SRE: Staging window available 2025-03-18 02:00-03:00 UTC. React :thumbsup: to accept.
DevOps-bot: Reminder: follow-up sync 2025-03-12 14:00 UTC.
Faye: Action recap: A1 prompt set (Faye) due 2025-03-10; A2 nightly eviction job (Omar) due 2025-03-15; A3 burst template (TBD) due 2025-03-14; A4 chaos drill + runbook (Omar + SRE) due 2025-03-18; A5 gating RFC (Omar) due 2025-03-15. Add tickets to the postmortem board and tag "remediation" + "evals". Keep CI-local tests small; run full-regressions nightly.
Omar: PRs will follow for prompt set and perf template. Ping me if infra approvals block.
